_note: All resist values are out of 16; dodge values are out of 64

enemy_attack_standard.description: Normal enemy physical attack when hero defense < enemy strength

hero_attack_standard.note: If result < 1: 50% chance to deal 0, 50% chance to deal 1

hero_attack_excellent.description: Critical hit — 1/32 chance per attack. Ignores enemy defense.
hero_attack_excellent.note: Not possible against Golem or either Dragonlord form

fire_strong.note: Only Dragonlord second form uses strong fire

sleep.hero_vs_enemy: Blocked by enemy resist_sleep (X/16 chance to resist). If lands: guaranteed 1 turn, then 1/3 chance to wake each turn. Max 6 turns due to RNG limits.
sleep.enemy_vs_hero: Always lands (no resistance). 50/50 chance to wake each turn. Max 6 turns.

stopspell.hero_vs_enemy: Blocked by enemy resist_stopspell (X/16). Never loses effect once landed.
stopspell.enemy_vs_hero: 50% chance to work. Erdrick's Armor: immune to stopspell.

running.enemy_runs: If hero_strength >= 2 * enemy_strength: 25% chance enemy runs each turn (also checked at encounter start)

hero_runs.formula: If hero_agility * RAND < enemy_agility * RAND * group_factor: blocked
hero_runs.note: Can always run from sleeping monsters. Can run from Dragonlord (restarts fight).

initiative.description: Same formula as hero running vs Group 1 enemies. If blocked, enemy goes first.

dodge.description: Enemy dodge chance is dodge_value / 64 per hero attack. Applies to excellent moves too.
dodge.note: Golem and Dragonlord have 0 dodge. Hero cannot dodge.
